Nad E Ali

Apples of Hope: Mannat for Ali Asghar (AS)

During Muharram, women take apples from the symbolic cradle of Ali Asghar (AS), the infant son of Imam Husayn (AS), offering prayers for fertility and the well-being of their children. An intimate ritual bringing together faith, motherhood, and hope.
